Dear iMerit Technology Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the AI Trainer - Video Annotation role. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I have developed a strong eye for detail and a commitment to accuracy that I believe aligns well with the requirements of this position.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to contribute.

Sincerely,

cover_letter:
Dear iMerit Technology Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the AI Trainer - Video Annotation position. As a digital marketer with a technical background, I have honed my attention to detail and analytical thinking through years of optimizing websites, analyzing data, and ensuring content accuracy. These skills are directly transferable to the meticulous work of video annotation.

In my freelance role, I conduct technical SEO audits, implement structured data, and manage content for various websites. This requires a keen eye for detail, the ability to follow complex guidelines, and a commitment to consistency—all essential for annotating video clips accurately. For example, I have built and optimized websites like mirook.com, where I implemented JSON-LD schema and ran iterative audits to improve search health scores. This involved identifying and correcting issues, much like evaluating video quality and relevance against established guidelines.

I am fluent in English and comfortable working independently with detailed instructions. While I am new to AI and robotics, I am a quick learner and have experience using AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT for research and content creation. I am confident that my analytical skills and dedication to accuracy will allow me to excel in this certification process and contribute to high-quality video data for robotics AI projects.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to demonstrate my skills.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking, demonstrated through technical SEO audits and structured data implementation.
• Fluent in English with the ability to follow detailed instructions independently, as shown in freelance and remote work.
• Commitment to accuracy and consistency, evidenced by managing content and ensuring quality across multiple websites.
• Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) and prompt engineering, indicating readiness to learn annotation guidelines.
• Analytical mindset and problem-solving skills from a computer science background and front-end development experience.
